privacy.s10Body: The app is not intended for anyone under 15. If you are a parent and believe your child has provided us with personal data, contact us to have it deleted.
privacy.s11Body: This policy may be updated to reflect legal or functional changes. In the event of a material change, users will be informed the next time they use the app.
privacy.s1Body: The data controller is {{company}}, publisher of the Sillage app, reachable at {{email}}. Full contact details are available in the legal notice.
privacy.s21Body:
When you create an account (optional), we collect your email address and a password.

If you use Google sign-in, we receive the name, email address and profile photo associated with your Google account.
privacy.s22Body:
As part of using the features, we store:
• Your favorite perfumes (hearts)
• Your perfumery (statuses, verdicts, personal notes, shelves, possessions)
• Your scent of the day (SOTD)
• Your scan history
• Your preferences (notifications, price alerts)
privacy.s23Body: When you scan a bottle, the photo is sent to OpenAI (GPT-4o Vision) to identify the perfume. Only the bottle image is sent — no other personal data. The photo is not retained by OpenAI after processing.
privacy.s24Body: If you enable notifications, a notification token (Expo Push Notifications) is stored to send you price alerts and, if you enable them, weather-related suggestions. You can turn off these notifications at any time in the settings.
privacy.s25Body: Certain preferences (theme, display density, views) and your recent searches are stored locally on your device via AsyncStorage. No sensitive data (password, contents of your perfumery) is stored locally: this is hosted on our servers.
privacy.s26Body: If you enable weather suggestions, your approximate location (rounded to ~1 km) is used to show the local weather and adapt perfume suggestions. It is requested only after your explicit consent, never collected without your knowledge, and can be erased at any time (Settings → Privacy & data).
privacy.s3Body:
Processing is based on the following legal grounds:
• Consent: account creation, Google sign-in, camera scanning, push notifications, weather suggestions (approximate location)
• Performance of a contract: saving your favorites and your perfumery
• Legitimate interest: theme preference (local storage only)
privacy.s41Body:
Authentication, the database, image storage and server functions ("Edge Functions") are provided by Supabase (PostgreSQL database). Your account data, favorites and perfumery are hosted in Supabase's Europe region.

Push notifications are delivered via the Expo Push Notifications service (Expo / 650 Industries, United States).

Supabase and Expo apply the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for data transfers outside the European Union.
privacy.s42Body:
Bottle photos are sent to OpenAI for visual analysis. OpenAI receives no personally identifying data. The images sent are not used to train OpenAI's models and are deleted after processing.

The OpenAI API key is stored exclusively on the server side (Supabase Edge Functions) and is never exposed to the client.
privacy.s43Body: Perfume data (brand, name, olfactory notes, price) is hosted in our PostgreSQL database (Supabase). Searches are performed within our catalog of more than 25,000 perfumes, hosted on our servers; no personal data is sent to any third-party service for these searches.
privacy.s44Body: If you choose Google sign-in, a standard OAuth authentication token is exchanged with Google's servers.
privacy.s5Body:
Supabase, Expo, OpenAI and Google (Google sign-in) are US companies. However, the core data is hosted in Supabase's Europe region, and these transfers are governed by:
• The Data Privacy Framework (DPF) for Google
• The European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)
• Storage of core data in Supabase's Europe region
privacy.s6Body:
• Account data: until the account is deleted
• Favorites and perfumery: until manually deleted or the account is deleted
• Scan history: until manually deleted or the account is deleted
• Photos sent to OpenAI: not retained (immediate processing, no storage)
• Notification token (Expo Push): until notifications are disabled or the account is deleted
• Local preferences: stored locally until the app is uninstalled
privacy.s7Body:
In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
• Right of access: obtain a copy of your data
• Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
• Right to erasure: request the deletion of your data
• Right to portability: receive your data in a structured format
• Right to object: object to certain processing
• Right to restriction: temporarily restrict processing
• Right to withdraw consent: at any time, without justification

To exercise these rights, you can use the features built into the app:
• Settings → Privacy & data → Export my data
• Settings → Privacy & data → Delete my account

You can also contact us at {{email}}.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
privacy.s8Body:
We implement the following technical measures:
• Secure authentication via Supabase Auth
• PostgreSQL database security rules (Row Level Security) restricting access to each user's data
• Encrypted transmission (HTTPS) for all communications
• Third-party API keys stored exclusively on the server side (Supabase Edge Functions)
privacy.s9Body:
The Sillage mobile app does not use cookies. Local storage on the device (via AsyncStorage) is limited to your preferences (theme, display density, views) and your recent searches.

The "View offer" buttons and the "Compare merchants" section may contain affiliate links: if you buy from a partner merchant through one of these links, Sillage may receive a commission, at no extra cost to you. These links do not add any tracking cookies in the app and do not influence the prices shown or the ranking of offers.
privacy.s9Title: 9. Cookies, local storage and partner links
privacy.title: Privacy policy
